SELECT id, title, content, category, tags, (
(CASE WHEN title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{w}, '%') THEN 3 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{w}, '%') THEN 2 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{w}, '%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
) AS score FROM knowledge_base
(title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{w}, '%') OR tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{w}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{w}, '%'))
ORDER BY score DESC, id DESC LIMIT 5
